Calendar.title: Calendar
Calendar.description: A department or grade-level pacing calendar for the 2026-2027 school year.

id.description: Unique slug identifier for the calendar.

name.description: Display name of the course or department calendar.

category.description: Navigation category grouping for the calendar.

isScience.description: Whether this calendar supports CA NGSS Integrated vs Discipline-Specific model filtering.

order.description: Display sort order within the calendar switcher.

createdByUid.description: UID of the staff or admin user who created the calendar.

updatedBy.description: Display name or email of the last user to modify this calendar.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

Standard.title: Standard
Standard.description: An academic standard assigned to a specific calendar with Essential, Supporting, Prerequisite, or Unassigned classification.

calendarId.description: ID of the parent calendar document.

code.description: Standard code such as 7.NS.A.1 or MS-PS1-1.

description.description: Full text description of the standard.

ngssModel.description: CA NGSS course model for Science standards.

updatedBy.description: Display name or email of the user who last classified or edited this standard.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who last updated this standard.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

Entry.title: Entry
Entry.description: A daily pacing entry for a specific calendar and date (YYYY-MM-DD).

calendarId.description: ID of the parent calendar document.

date.description: ISO date string in YYYY-MM-DD format within 2026-2027.

topic.description: Short lesson or pacing topic title.

notes.description: Optional brief details, PLC notes, or resource links.

dayTag.description: Optional day type or assessment indicator (Flex Day, Activity, CFA, PM1, BM1, CA, etc.).

standardIds.description: Array of tagged standard document IDs (max 30).

updatedBy.description: Display name or email of the user who last edited this entry.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who last updated this entry.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Explicitly granted admin record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin user.

email.description: Verified email address of the admin user.

grantedBy.description: Email or name of the admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/calendars/{calendarId}.description: Department and grade-level pacing calendars for 2026-2027.

/entries/{entryId}.description: Daily pacing entries keyed deterministically as {calendarId}__{YYYY-MM-DD}.

/admins/{uid}.description: Admin role grants keyed by user UID.
